text:
ashley: Quick heads-up — planning a small router header shim change during the 23:00 UTC change window. Affects API, runtime, and console. Need a short pin/unpin + rollback plan. deploy-bot will orchestrate.
deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2024-08-12 23:00 UTC (60m). Suggested pins: runtime=3.4.2, router=2.9.0-shim, console=1.8.5-canary. Use `/deploy pin runtime=3.4.2 router=2.9.0-shim console=1.8.5` to lock variants.
sven: Are there any DB migrations or schema bumps?
laura: No DB migrations. Runtime needs a KV cache flush post-rollout. We'll run `curl -XPOST /internal/cache/flush` from deploy-bot after traffic shift.
mike: Rollback criteria? what metrics to watch for auto-rollback?
ashley: Primary criteria: p95 inference latency increase > 200ms sustained for 5m OR error rate increase > 0.5% absolute above baseline. Secondary: console timeout spikes and router 5xx > 0.2% for 10m. If hit, trigger rollback.
jin: Where are release notes/PRs? who owns post-deploy checks?
ashley: PR 5523 has the shim details + rollout steps (link pasted in the thread). Laura owns monitoring and smoke. Jin will own the release notes and after-action checklist.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks: config hashes aligned? runtime config OK? router health endpoints OK? Please ack.
laura: ack — configs match. I ran a dry smoke against staging, no regressions.
mike: ack. I'll stand by to monitor API traces and open an incident if latency climbs.
sven: ack. I'll watch routing layer and keep a patch branch ready to revert shim.
laura: Smoke plan: 3 rounds — 5 req/s to router shim paths, validate p50/p95, verify KV read success. Post-traffic shift run cache flush and then 1k-samples perf test.
deploy-bot: Canary plan: route 5% traffic for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% if stable. If rollback triggered at any stage, deploy-bot will pin previous variants and route 100% to runtime=3.4.1 and router=2.9.0 (non-shim).
jin: I'll write the release note summary and add rollback steps + links to smoke scripts in the PR.
ashley: One more ask — console team: please keep the console canary monitorable; don't auto-scale down canaries during the window.
laura: noted. I'll add an alert dashboard widget and a small runbook snippet under #release-ops.
mike: we good to pin now?
deploy-bot: Pins applied: runtime=3.4.2, router=2.9.0-shim, console=1.8.5-canary. Rolling canary schedule set.
ashley: great. I'll kick the window 10m before and ping here when we begin the first traffic ramp. :thumbsup:
laura: ready on monitoring.
sven: ready on router fallback branch.
mike: monitoring on-call armed.
jin: release notes drafted, will push final when canary passes.
ashley: thanks all — small and tidy window, call if anything odd.
